cards.title: Spoon Ferry Lunchbox Harbor
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable sequence card for a tiny spoon ferry voyage with three clear lunchbox harbor stops: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Place the card beside a pencil and one folded paper dock, then name the pretend ferry cargo together: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write what happens as the spoon ferry loads, crosses, pauses, and docks in order: ____________________.
cards.firstPrompt: First, the spoon ferry picks up ____________________ from the lunchbox dock.
cards.nextPrompt: Next, the harbor water makes the ferry ____________________.
cards.thenPrompt: Then, the crumb captain asks for ____________________ before docking.
cards.finallyPrompt: Finally, the ferry delivers ____________________ and the harbor settles.
cards.transitionPrompt: Add one crossing transition such as after that, soon, or at last before ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back and circle the event that could not happen before ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Sketch three small harbor boxes and label the last one ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Retell the spoon ferry trip in order, ending with ____________________.

cards.title: Acorn Avenue Errand Office
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable card for sorting a busy pretend errand into a clean order: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Set out three scrap-paper errand tickets and tell the writer the Acorn Avenue office is invented: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write the errand in the order the acorn office handles it from drawer to stamp: ____________________.
cards.firstPrompt: First, the acorn clerk opens the drawer and finds ____________________.
cards.nextPrompt: Next, the paperclip messenger carries ____________________ down Acorn Avenue.
cards.thenPrompt: Then, the leaf counter discovers ____________________ is in the wrong tray.
cards.finallyPrompt: Finally, the office stamps the errand with ____________________.
cards.transitionPrompt: Use an order word to show when ____________________ moves from one desk to the next.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back and fix one event if ____________________ happens too early.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Number four acorn-office moments and mark ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Retell the errand with first, next, then, and finally using ____________________.

cards.title: Seed Library Map Room
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable card for following one pretend seed packet as it moves through a fictional map room: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Give the writer one index card as a pretend seed packet and one blank map square: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write a sequence where the labeled seed packet moves through shelves, drawers, and map marks: ____________________.
cards.firstPrompt: First, the seed packet is placed on ____________________.
cards.nextPrompt: Next, the map room ladder, drawer, or stamp helps it move to ____________________.
cards.thenPrompt: Then, the packet is almost mixed up with ____________________.
cards.finallyPrompt: Finally, the packet reaches the right map shelf and ____________________.
cards.transitionPrompt: Use a movement transition such as across, into, under, or beside before ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check that the seed packet appears in every event, then add the missing spot: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw four tiny boxes and place the packet in box ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Save the finished card as a pretend library map label for ____________________.

cards.title: Rain Gauge Railway
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable card for linking each rain railway event to the reason it happens next: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Lay a paper strip as the railway line and explain that the rain gauge, train, and station are pretend: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write a paper-only railway story where each event causes the next event in the chain: ____________________.
cards.firstPrompt: First, the rain gauge fills to the mark that says ____________________.
cards.nextPrompt: Next, because of that, the tiny railway conductor decides to ____________________.
cards.thenPrompt: Then, that choice causes the platform crew to ____________________.
cards.finallyPrompt: Finally, the rain train arrives with ____________________.
cards.transitionPrompt: Add one cause transition such as because, so, or therefore before ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back and underline the event that causes ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw a cause-and-effect arrow from ____________________ to the last stop.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Tell the railway chain using one because sentence about ____________________.

cards.title: Moss Message Observatory
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable card for revealing a quiet observatory message one detail at a time: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Fold a paper telescope strip and invite the writer to imagine a desk-drawer observatory with invented rooms: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write the moss message sequence by adding one useful clue before the next clue appears: ____________________.
cards.firstPrompt: First, the observatory lens notices ____________________ glowing in the moss.
cards.nextPrompt: Next, the moss message adds a smaller clue about ____________________.
cards.thenPrompt: Then, the watcher compares both clues and realizes ____________________.
cards.finallyPrompt: Finally, the full moss message says ____________________.
cards.transitionPrompt: Add a clue-order transition such as next, later, or finally before ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back and remove any clue that explains ____________________ before the moss reveals it.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: List four moss clues and put a box around ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Share the moss message in order, saving ____________________ for last.
